data.content:
I submitted the dispute for DD-48267 for owner approval. The first attempt was rejected because I had cited the ticket evidence, which the system counts as neutral. I removed that citation and resubmitted once, and the second attempt passed.

The dispute now cites only the pickup handoff: the order was ready at 12:52 and picked up at 12:55. The ticket listing the Peanut Butter Bowl is still mentioned in the text, but without an evidence id, and the dispute says the ticket alone doesn't show what was packed. I left out the repeat-claimant count so the dispute doesn't characterize the customer.
